creation.setupTextNote: Text-only alternative for chat, writing, tools and structured answers. Download na about {{size}}. E need more memory than {{defaultModel}} and e no dey process image or audio by itself. To read answers aloud, e dey use system voice. Choose am for text work if memory plenty. Check facts with sources.
creation.setupImageNote: FLUX.2 Klein 4B Q4_K_M di make picture. Qwen3 di encode weti you describe, an VAE di bring out di final picture. Change shape ratio, resolution, seed, steps an upscaling. For start: 21:9, four steps an random seed.
creation.setupMusicNote: ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo di make music wey no get singing, or song. Di planner di arrange am, di 2B Q4_K_M generator di make di sound, di text encoder di handle di description, an VAE di decode stereo 48 kHz sound. Change time, audio format, tempo, song words, language, steps an seed. Better start: 30 seconds, eight steps, WAV 24-bit an random seed.
creation.setupVideoNote: Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B Q4_K_M di make clips from weti you describe. Better start: five seconds, 21:9 an 16 FPS. Change time, frame rate, resolution, steps an seed. Long video di join small clips. You fit see place wey dem join. · MP4: Python + imageio-ffmpeg.
creation.setupAllNote: Downloads and configures recommended models: LFM3-Omni + mmproj for text, Qwen3-Embedding Q8_0 for multilingual retrieval (CPU by default), FLUX.2 Klein 4B (Picture) and its components, Real-ESRGAN ×2/×4, ACE-Step for music (Instrumental on by default), and Wan2.1 for video. Check file sizes, disk space and video prerequisites below. Separate downloads and Browse still dey available.
creation.videoDurationNote: Na short clips dem dey join to make long video. You fit see where dem join, and e fit take long time to create.
creation.configure: Choose cloud model with API key, or set local engine and files wey e need for creation settings.
creation.localNote: Local pictures use complete Diffusers folder, separate GGUF/Safetensors files with stable-diffusion.cpp, or native NVFP4 CUDA weights wey we support with Python. Video use Diffusers. For engines wey use separate files, choose CPU or GPU for encoder and picture generator separately.

creation.ggufImageModel: Diffusion model (GGUF or Safetensors weh e match)
creation.ggufTextEncoder: Text encoder (GGUF or Safetensors weh e match)
creation.ggufVae: VAE (GGUF or Safetensors weh e match)
creation.ggufNote: Choose diffusion model, text encoder an VAE separate. Fo FLUX.2 Klein 4B, use Qwen3-4B encoder weh e match, including di GGUF version dem. Dem prepare NVFP4 file dem weh e support one time with Python an PyTorch inside bigger compatibility cache. Di original file dem no change. E need extra space fo disk an RAM. Fo Windows, Novera bring di engine an manage am by itself. Automatic mode use hardware weh e dey. CUDA need CUDA build. Distilled Klein usually use 4 steps an CFG 1. E no download any weights.
creation.ggufWrongModel: This GGUF na text encoder. Choose am for encoder field, then choose separate diffusion model for picture field.
creation.nativeNote: Native NVFP4 CUDA: FLUX.2 Klein 4B weights for Comfy, Qwen3-4B GGUF encoder an FLUX.2 Safetensors VAE. E need Blackwell (RTX 50 series or one wey match), Python, CUDA PyTorch an di optional NVFP4 parts. Na text to picture only. Hardware wey no match go show error. Choose stable-diffusion.cpp for compatibility. No BF16 diffusion cache. Novera di read Qwen direct from di GGUF file.
creation.generationDevice: Make am with: CPU or GPU
creation.deviceNote: Choose device for each component separately. Auto use hardware wey dey. Native NVFP4 need GPU wey match for picture creation, and use GPU for text if free VRAM reach. Qwen for CPU fit save VRAM but encoding fit slow. Qwen for GPU move layers as e need dem. For stable-diffusion.cpp, Auto follow engine wey you choose; CUDA need CUDA build.
creation.totalTimeHint: Total time include loading, text encoding, generation, any cloud waiting, download and saving. We show generation time separately when engine measure am.
creation.recommendedSetupNote: GPU go generate, Qwen3-4B go use CPU, 4 steps, CFG 1. Dem test am for Windows/Vulkan; speed and compatibility depend on your machine.
creation.seedNote: Na only local image. Compare with di same model and settings.
creation.imageResolutionMax: Di highest resolution for Novera: 2048 × 2048 px. You need enough memory.
creation.upscaleNote: After generation. You need Python/PyTorch. Highest output: ×2 4096 × 4096, ×4 8192 × 8192.
creation.upscaleMissing: Prepare and check di local components wey you need for Novera · Configurations.
creation.sizeAutoNote: Change ratio and di current resolution go adjust. Dimensions na multiples of 16, up to 2048 px.
creation.setupTextNvfp4Note: Optional NVFP4 weights for NVIDIA Blackwell GPU wey app detect, or newer GPU, wey get at least 4.5 GiB VRAM. Before you fit use these weights for Novera, convert the full model repository to compatible NVFP4 GGUF and validate am. Nobody don verify this conversion for this checkpoint yet. The built-in engine no fit load the linked Safetensors file directly. Q8_0 still be the recommendation wey ready to use. Memory wey e need still depend on context length.
creation.setupOmniNote: Na default model for desktop and mobile. Dis small model dey handle text, image and audio with di required {{projector}} file. Di two files na about {{size}} to download. Choose am for lighter multimodal setup. Voice features depend on di platform and engine. Longer context dey use more memory.

instructions.textDefault: You be Novera. Answer clear, correct and short for di user's language. Follow wetin dem ask, check important facts if you fit, and talk when you no sure. No invent sources, results or work wey you never do.
instructions.imageDefault: Follow di subject, style and framing wey dem ask for. Make composition clear, lighting consistent and details clean. Keep reference identity; avoid distortion and unwanted things. Add text only if dem ask.
instructions.videoDefault: Follow di subject, style and duration wey dem ask for. Keep characters, objects and lighting consistent across frames. Use smooth movement and controlled camera. Avoid flicker, distortion and text wey dem no ask for.
